resolved_revision_source: Hugging Face repository API, independently checked through hf-mirror after the primary endpoint failed
architecture: Perception Encoder Core ViT-S/16 with 8-head attention pooling
feature: official final attention-pooled and projected PE-Core image embedding
preprocessing: official timm pretrained config: bicubic resize/center crop, mean 0.5, std 0.5
selection_protocol: per-sample L2 normalization, train-only 5-fold C selection, LinearSVC refit on 434 train images, one validation evaluation
notes: Meta's official repository documents timm integration for PE and lists PE-Core-S16-384 as a 384px ViT-S/16 with a 512-dimensional CLIP embedding. This experiment uses the timm-converted official checkpoint and its native final image embedding, not an intermediate token or a trained Bai-pattern head.
